_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Task Closure Record Request
summary: The Task Closure Record Request provides a permanent and static record of the contractor's accomplishments under the task and NSWC, Corona approval thereof.
use_relationship:
The Task Closure Record Request provides a permanent and static record of the contractor's accomplishments under the task, and NSWC, Corona approval thereof.
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Task Closure Record Request shall be presented using NSWC approved contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Task Closure Record Request shall include a request to close the task. It shall include the following:

children.title: Contractor Site Manager's signature and shall be addressed to the government on site manager.
Task number and title, work order number, and table that shows a list of deliverables.
Indication of completion of each item in the task request, or an explanation of why the item was not completed.
A summary of all costs incurred in the completion of the task, including labor, materials, subcontract fees, etc.
A certification from the contractor's Engineering Manager that any resulting configuration changes have been recorded in accordance with the Engineering and Configuration Management Plan.
A request for approval to the government's on site manager to close the task, and a summary of the task's information (task number, title, and work order number).
Attachments that include screen shots of cost information, e-mail messages, etc. when applicable.
